## Visualise (R)

```{r}
library(arrow); library(ggplot2)
df <- read_parquet("../../data/processed/clean.parquet")
ggplot(df, aes(feature_1, fill = factor(target))) + geom_density(alpha = .4) + theme_minimal()
```
